publicRepository.contents: Readable reports, coverage, execution plans and logs, source manifests, and evidence names and digests.

completeEvidence.reason: Automatic approval review rejected publishing opaque compressed full evidence payloads to the public GitHub repository.
completeEvidence.archiveReferences: The archive file fields identify paths inside the private bundle, not public repository downloads.

distribution.checksumScope: Public SHA256SUMS covers only the published files in this directory, excluding itself. The private bundle preserves the original complete SHA256SUMS.

interpretation: The reported parse_failures counter is distinct from per-file parse_status and semantic relation coverage. REA 6.7.0 marks parse_status partial when parser errors OR unknown static findings exist; partial is preserved verbatim rather than treated as a parser failure.
Aggregate resource omissions motivated smaller caller-selected analyses; source selection does not implicitly analyze dependencies.
All selected critical code sources have retained non-module semantic nodes and no reported resource omission in their shard. This is not proof of complete semantics.
Shard graphs remain partial because unselected files and dynamic calls, properties, values or targets stay unknown. Cross-shard relationships were not joined or proven.
Counts of findings, unknowns or zero parser/integrity errors are not vulnerability counts and do not mean zero vulnerabilities.
Evidence inspects inert source bytes; execution, provider delivery, database behavior, browser behavior, deployment and credentials require separate runtime evidence.
The V1 aggregate is historical and must not certify the modified V2 integration code.
Manifest tree SHA-256 and REA artifact SHA-256 use different identity schemes; both are retained.
